basis: Warm softly lit cartoon, fixed Rowan target with authorized native remodeling and purposeful decoration. Reward useful changes to forms/proportions/construction rather than literal source part counts.

shapeVolume.required: A visibly more coherent, rounded dimensional Rowan than the original: cap crown and visor form credible headwear, ginger wave/fringe/moustache forms are deliberate, head/ear/hand forms feel sculpted, clothing has readable thickness and construction. All four actual facings retain one consistent character.
observablePass: Cap/hair overlap looks intentional rather than a sawtooth row cutting through a flat visor.
Cheeks, nose, moustache and eyes remain readable and friendly at logical size; no melted facial forms or obscured identity.
Profiles and rear have purposeful cap/hair/clothing construction without abrupt exposed ends, lumpy accidental seams or one-view-only fixes.
Any useful redesign fits original functional/animation envelope and preserves contact paths.

color.required: Preserve light warm tan skin, ginger hair/moustache, cyan/turquoise cap, ivory coat, green apron, teal tie and dark shoes. Warm coherent values separate these parts without washed-out cyan or muddy green/ginger.
observablePass: Front/profile/back retain matching palette and material behavior.
Cap, hair, face, collar, tie and apron remain visually separable at logical size.

lightingHighlights.required: Broad soft illumination reveals curvature and adds warmth with controlled highlights; no preferred horizontal light direction on these rotatable sprites and no directional ground shadow.
observablePass: Cap, face, hair, sleeves and apron show soft readable volume rather than flat slabs or razor-hot rim lighting.
No black/dead patches, blown ivory highlights, dirty contact shading or view-specific color changes.
Transparent edges are clean on light, gray and dark backgrounds without target halo imitation.

materialDetail.required: A few purposeful, readable construction details in cap, collar/cuffs, kerchief and green apron/pocket/belt make Rowan feel crafted; material response remains compatible with warm cartoon family.
observablePass: Clothing layers show clear boundary/thickness without looking like disconnected blocks.
Detail supports function and silhouette at logical192x320; stitches/grain are optional and may be omitted if subpixel.
Metal knife remains a native prop; salmon remains explicitly the existing2D sprite.

artifactFreeReadability.required: At logical192x320 and enlarged views, all192 frames are stable, recognizable and free of material defects; actions remain readable in all four facings.
observablePass: No clipping, unintentional interpenetration, flickering topology, jagged dark seams, detached details, disappearing materials or silhouette pops.
All12fps state/facing playbacks preserve the authored small bob, work action, held composition and out-and-back nonlooping load.
Source-authorized 2D salmon depth bias/occlusion is evaluated separately from native body footprint; no demand to turn it into3D sushi or relocate it.

immutableTechnical.registration: Exact recorded35degree character orthographic camera, logical192x320, logicalroot96,248, published2x384x640 and atlas6x2 arrangement with original rect order. Preserve world scale and ground root; no per-frame/view fitting, pose shift, pixel warp or camera cheat.
immutableTechnical.directions: S0/E+90/N180/W-90 publisher yaw with original intrinsic child orientation retained; evaluate all four actual facings.
immutableTechnical.rigAndAnimation: Keep native25-bone rig/rest, original clips/action behavior and all evaluated foot, hand, dish and utensil contact paths. Four states×four directions×12 unique-frame slots=192 native frames and16 atlases at12fps. Idle/work/hold loop; load does not. No invented walking state or replacement load trajectory.
immutableTechnical.heightAndClearance: Keep nominal functionalheight1.3968749344, occupied one-cellXY footprint and original native physical body/knife clearance; retain original phase-specific motion/bob, whose measured source animated top reaches1.3986088037. Source audit is the comparison baseline for evaluated envelope/contact paths.
immutableTechnical.heldComposition: Preserve packed salmon image SHA2565de7475813a133bb643fa9de09adbef104c7bd20a572514a297cba54846ceafe, fixed alpha UV/registration,0.35world-cell display width, yaw-cancellation and0.6camera-ray depth bias; declared2D plane excluded from physical body-footprint measurement. Keep native knife native.
immutableTechnical.dependencyClosure: All textures/libraries required by the isolated asset must be packed or hash-bound and available; no foreign rig/modifier/constraint targets. Editable native source and exact native renders required.

requiredCandidateEvidence: Immutable hash-bound packet containing native.blend, resources, all192 native frames/16 original-layout atlases and technical validation.
All-frame contact sheets plus per-state/per-facing actual12fps playback, consistent-registration comparison and light/gray/dark readability.
Native audit from saved/reopened source: camera/root/height and phase-specific body/knife envelope, rest skeleton, every frame contact path, closing-frame policy, no missing dependencies.
Technical evidence distinguishes2D salmon plane from body/native knife and does not relabel2D artwork as modeled sushi.
decisionPolicy: Approve only visible improvement toward fixed target across all required facings/states plus passing immutable technical contract and no material defects. Missing evidence means needs_evidence. No universal score threshold. At most three ranked blockers per candidate review.
